columns.name: invoiceNumber
columns.description: Invoice number, unique

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer display name (denormalised)

columns.name: salesAgentName
columns.description: Sales agent name

columns.name: invoiceDate
columns.description: Invoice date

columns.name: dueDate
columns.description: Due date

columns.name: dueMonth
columns.description: Due month YYYY-MM

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Invoice amount ILS

columns.name: openAmount
columns.description: Open amount ILS

columns.name: status
columns.description: Invoice status

columns.name: deliveryNotesExpected
columns.description: Delivery notes expected

columns.name: deliveryNotesAttached
columns.description: Delivery notes attached

columns.name: missingDeliveryNotes
columns.description: Some delivery notes are missing

columns.name: hasZeroPriceLines
columns.description: Invoice has zero-price lines

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-mock, priority-file (uploaded Priority export), priority-api, or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures)

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last synced from Priority

columns.name: documentType
columns.description: Document type

columns.name: sourceDocUrl
columns.description: The invoice as it was sent to the customer (image/PDF from the Priority attachments). Test invoices get a stamped copy from BuildTestInvoiceDocuments

columns.name: productLine
columns.description: Product line, used to route missing delivery-note chases to logistics

columns.name: paymentState
columns.description: App layer (never written by the Priority sync): payment we have seen. נראה תשלום = an approved receipt match pays this invoice and the receipt is not yet in Priority; נקלט ב-Priority = the match was marked done in Priority. Empty = no payment seen by the app. Recomputed by the shared invoice-layer code

columns.name: paidSeenAmount
columns.description: App layer: ILS of this invoice paid by approved receipt matches (sum of their allocations)

columns.name: paidSeenAt
columns.description: App layer: when the latest approved match on this invoice was approved

columns.name: paidSeenBankLineIds
columns.description: App layer: comma-separated bank line ids of the approved matches

columns.name: paidPriorityDoneAt
columns.description: App layer: when the receipt was marked done in Priority (latest of the matches)

columns.name: layerUpdatedAt
columns.description: App layer: when the payment and note fields above were last recomputed

columns.name: paymentStatus
columns.description: App layer (never written by the Priority sync): payment status from our receipt allocations. פתוחה = nothing allocated; שולמה חלקית = allocated less than Priority's open amount; שולמה = fully allocated. Priority's own status stays in status.

columns.name: remainingAmount
columns.description: App layer: what is still open after our receipt allocations = openAmount − paidSeenAmount while Priority has not reflected them, else openAmount. The aging report and the customer card show this

columns.name: receiptKeys
columns.description: App layer: comma-separated Receipts.receiptKey of the receipts allocated to this invoice

columns.name: subStatus
columns.description: Our layer: the one sub-status shown, by precedence בבירור > שולמה חלקית > פתוחה; סגורה when nothing is left open (הובטחה is no longer set: commitments are CustomerNotes per customer + due month)

columns.name: openDisputeId
columns.description: Our layer: the open dispute on the invoice (text link to Disputes.id)

columns.name: priorityKey
columns.description: Sync: Priority natural key (<priorityForm>:<IVNUM>, e.g. CINVOICES:MF26001079). Written only by SyncFromBrain.

columns.name: sourceUpdatedAt
columns.description: Sync: last change time in Priority when the source reports one, else null.

columns.name: syncRunId
columns.description: Sync: SyncRuns.runId of the run that last wrote this row.

columns.name: lastAppWriteAt
columns.description: Sync: when the app last wrote this row to Priority (write-through). A sync whose Brain data is older skips the row.

columns.name: pendingBrainConfirm
columns.description: Sync: true after an app write-through until a Brain sync newer than lastAppWriteAt confirms it.

columns.name: deletedInSource
columns.description: Sync: true when a fully-read Brain table no longer contains this key. Row and enrichment are kept.

columns.name: priorityForm
columns.description: Mirror: the Priority form the document comes from

columns.name: priorityDocStatus
columns.description: Mirror: document status in Priority (STATDES verbatim: סופית / מבוטלת / טיוטא). Not the payment status.

columns.name: reconciledDate
columns.description: Mirror: reconciliation date in Priority (IVRECONDATE); null while not reconciled

columns.name: currencyCode
columns.description: Mirror: document currency (CODE, e.g. שח / USD)
